######dependent & independent variables######
```{r, get the CRU data and prepare it }
library(raster)
library(tidyverse)
library(ncdf4)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(devtools)
library(geosphere)  
library(countrycode)
library(R.utils)
library(patchwork) 
library(readxl)
library(janitor)

# List all .gz files for temp and precipitation
#gz_files <- list.files("C:/Users/Pauli/Documents/Uni 6. Semester/Bachelor Arbeit/Data Teil/CRU data", pattern = "\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)

# Unzip all of them if not already extracted
#for (gz in gz_files) {
  #nc_name <- sub("\\.gz$", "", gz)  
  #if (!file.exists(nc_name)) {
    #message("Unzipping: ", gz)
    #R.utils::gunzip(gz, overwrite = FALSE)
  #}
#}
#The code above is written as comments, as it only needs to run once and would stop the run after this first time. It is needed for replicability though, as the raw data needs to be unpacked first

# Load temperature (CRU)
t1 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.1991.2000.tmp.dat.nc", varname = "tmp")
t2 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.2001.2010.tmp.dat.nc", varname = "tmp")

# Load temperature (1961–1990 = baseline)
t0_1 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.1961.1970.tmp.dat.nc", varname = "tmp")
t0_2 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.1971.1980.tmp.dat.nc", varname = "tmp")
t0_3 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.1981.1990.tmp.dat.nc", varname = "tmp")
t0 <- stack(t0_1, t0_2, t0_3)

# Load precipitation (CRU)
p1 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.1991.2000.pre.dat.nc", varname = "pre")
p2 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.2001.2010.pre.dat.nc", varname = "pre")

# Load precipitation (1961–1990 = baseline)
p0_1 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.1961.1970.pre.dat.nc", varname = "pre")
p0_2 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.1971.1980.pre.dat.nc", varname = "pre")
p0_3 <- brick("cru_ts4.07.1981.1990.pre.dat.nc", varname = "pre")
p0 <- stack(p0_1, p0_2, p0_3)

# Subset 1996–2010
t_hist <- subset(t1, 61:120)
t_future <- subset(t2, 1:120)
temp_stack <- stack(t_hist, t_future)

p_hist <- subset(p1, 61:120)
p_future <- subset(p2, 1:120)
pre_stack <- stack(p_hist, p_future)

# Crop to Africa
africa_extent <- extent(-20, 55, -40, 40)
temp_stack <- crop(temp_stack, africa_extent)
pre_stack <- crop(pre_stack, africa_extent)
t0 <- crop(t0, africa_extent)
p0 <- crop(p0, africa_extent)

# Aggregate to 1° resolution
temp_1deg <- aggregate(temp_stack, fact = 2, fun = mean)
pre_1deg <- aggregate(pre_stack, fact = 2, fun = mean)
temp_base_1deg <- aggregate(t0, fact = 2, fun = mean)
pre_base_1deg <- aggregate(p0, fact = 2, fun = mean)

# Convert to tidy data frames
extract_climate <- function(r, var) {
  df <- as.data.frame(rasterToPoints(r))
  df_long <- df %>%
    rename(lon = x, lat = y) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("X"), names_to = "date", values_to = var) %>%
    mutate(
      date = gsub("X", "", date),
      year = as.integer(substr(date, 1, 4)),
      month = as.integer(substr(date, 6, 7))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(lon, lat, year, month, !!sym(var))
  return(df_long)
}

temp_df <- extract_climate(temp_1deg, "temperature")
pre_df  <- extract_climate(pre_1deg, "precipitation")
baseline_temp_df <- extract_climate(temp_base_1deg, "temperature")
baseline_pre_df  <- extract_climate(pre_base_1deg, "precipitation")

# Get monthly baseline averages (1961–1990)
monthly_baseline_temp <- baseline_temp_df %>%
  group_by(lon, lat, month) %>%
  summarise(temp_1961_1990 = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

monthly_baseline_precip <- baseline_pre_df %>%
  group_by(lon, lat, month) %>%
  summarise(precip_1961_1990 = mean(precipitation, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Merge climate + baselines + anomalies
climate_grid <- left_join(temp_df, pre_df, by = c("lon", "lat", "year", "month")) %>%
  left_join(monthly_baseline_temp, by = c("lon", "lat", "month")) %>%
  left_join(monthly_baseline_precip, by = c("lon", "lat", "month")) %>%
  mutate(
    temp_anomaly = temperature - temp_1961_1990 - 0.3,  # shift to preindustrial
    precip_anomaly = precipitation - precip_1961_1990
  )

# Assign country
coords <- climate_grid %>% 
  dplyr::select(lon, lat)
africa_sf <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(continent = "Africa", scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
grid_sf <- st_as_sf(climate_grid, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
grid_sf_buffered <- st_buffer(grid_sf, dist = 0.01)
grid_with_country <- st_join(grid_sf_buffered, africa_sf["name"])

# Final tidy dataset
climate_grid_country <- grid_with_country %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  bind_cols(coords) %>%
  rename(country = name) %>%
  filter(!is.na(country)) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, month, lon, lat, country,
         temperature, temp_anomaly,
         precipitation, precip_anomaly)

# Check on the results on map
africa_map <- ne_countries(continent = "Africa", scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Create a flag for whether a country was assigned
climate_grid_country <- climate_grid_country %>%
  mutate(country_assigned = !is.na(country))

# Convert to sf for plotting
climate_points_sf <- st_as_sf(climate_grid_country, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Plot: Assigned vs. unassigned
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = africa_map, fill = "gray95", color = "black") +
  geom_sf(data = climate_points_sf, aes(color = country_assigned), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE"="red", "TRUE"= "blue"), labels = c("FALSE" = "Unassigned","TRUE"="Assigned")) +
  labs(title = "Grid Cells Assigned to Countries",
       subtitle = "Blue = assigned, Red = missing country",
       color = "Country assigned?") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r, loading EMDAT}
# Load EM-DAT 
emdat <- read_excel("public_emdat_custom_request_2025-04-28_d69ff580-5c40-4e1d-980f-c5ad95b493a1.xlsx", sheet = "EM-DAT Data")

# Clean column names 
emdat <- janitor::clean_names(emdat)

# Select relevant disasters
emdat <- emdat %>% 
  dplyr::filter(disaster_type %in% c("Storm", "Flood", "Drought", "Extreme Temperature", "Glacial lake outburst flood", "Mass movement (wet)", "Wildfire"))

# Keep relevant columns
emdat_slim <- emdat %>%
  dplyr::select(country, start_year, start_month, disaster_type, total_deaths) %>%
  rename(year = start_year, month = start_month)

# Collapse to deadliest disaster
emdat_slim <- emdat_slim %>%
  group_by(country, year, month) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_deaths, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Join with other data
climate_grid_final <- climate_grid_country %>%
  left_join(emdat_slim, by = c("country", "year", "month")) %>%
  mutate(disaster_occurred = ifelse(is.na(disaster_type), 0, 1)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-total_deaths)

# Create disaster dummy
climate_grid_final$disaster_occurred <- ifelse(is.na(climate_grid_final$disaster_type), 0, 1)

# Drop the country_assigned
climate_grid_final <- climate_grid_final %>% 
  dplyr::select(-country_assigned)

glimpse(climate_grid_final)
```

```{r, join in UCPD}
# Loading the GED data
ged <- read.csv("GEDEvent.csv")

# Clean and round GED coordinates to match grid
ged1 <- ged %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    month = as.integer(month),
    lon = round(lon),   # rounding to 1-degree grid
    lat = round(lat)
  )

# Clean 
ged1 <- ged1 %>% 
  dplyr::select( id, year, type_of_violence, lat, lon, best, month) 

# Aggregate by grid cell + month
ged_grid <- ged1 %>%
  group_by(lon, lat, year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    deaths = sum(best, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    conflict_any = ifelse(deaths >= 1, 1, 0),
    conflict_10plus = ifelse(deaths >= 10, 1, 0),
    conflict_25plus = ifelse(deaths >= 25, 1, 0)
  )
table(ged_grid$conflict_10plus)

# Preparing for merge
ged_grid <- ged_grid %>%
  mutate(
    lon = as.integer(round(lon)),
    lat = as.integer(round(lat))
  )

# Same for climate grid 
climate_grid_country <- climate_grid_final %>%
  mutate(
    lon = as.integer(round(lon)),
    lat = as.integer(round(lat))
  )

# Merge into climate+disaster grid
final_data <- climate_grid_country %>%
  left_join(ged_grid, by = c("lon", "lat", "year", "month")) %>%
  mutate(
    conflict_any = ifelse(is.na(conflict_any), 0, conflict_any),
    conflict_10plus = ifelse(is.na(conflict_10plus), 0, conflict_10plus),
    conflict_25plus = ifelse(is.na(conflict_25plus), 0, conflict_25plus),
    deaths = ifelse(is.na(deaths), 0, deaths)) 

# Ceck
table(final_data$conflict_25plus)

# Look at data on Map
conflict_points <- final_data %>%
  filter(conflict_10plus == 1) %>%
  distinct(lon, lat)

conflict_sf <- st_as_sf(conflict_points, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = africa_map, fill = "gray95", color = "black") +
  geom_sf(data = conflict_sf, color = "darkred", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Conflict-Affected Grid Cells (≥1 Fatality)",
       subtitle = "UCDP GED data mapped to 1° x 1° grid",
       caption = "Source: UCDP GED") +
  theme_minimal()

# Save 
write.csv(final_data, "NEWclimateconflict.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, conflict history}
# Load data
final_data <- read.csv("NEWclimateconflict.csv")

# Create date column
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste(year, month, "15", sep = "-")))

# Create lagged variable for past month
final_data <- final_data %>%
  arrange(lon, lat, date) %>%
  group_by(lon, lat) %>%
  mutate(
    lagged_deaths = dplyr::lag(deaths, n = 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
table(final_data$lagged_deaths)
```

```{r, nightlights control}
# Getting the data
#untar("C:/Users/Pauli/Documents/Uni 6. Semester/Bachelor Arbeit/Data Teil/F121995.v4.tar", exdir = "nightlights_1995")
#untar("C:/Users/Pauli/Documents/Uni 6. Semester/Bachelor Arbeit/Data Teil/F152000.v4.tar", exdir = "nightlights_2000")
#untar("C:/Users/Pauli/Documents/Uni 6. Semester/Bachelor Arbeit/Data Teil/F162005.v4.tar", exdir = "nightlights_2005")
#untar("C:/Users/Pauli/Documents/Uni 6. Semester/Bachelor Arbeit/Data Teil/F182010.v4.tar", exdir = "nightlights_2010")

# Unzipping the files
#gunzip("F121995.v4b_web.stable_lights.avg_vis.tif.gz", remove = FALSE)
#gunzip("F152000.v4b_web.stable_lights.avg_vis.tif.gz", remove = FALSE)
#gunzip("F162005.v4b_web.stable_lights.avg_vis.tif.gz", remove = FALSE)
#gunzip("F182010.v4d_web.stable_lights.avg_vis.tif.gz", remove = FALSE)
# As in the beginning this code is only needed once

# Loading the data
nl_raster95 <- raster("F121995.v4b_web.stable_lights.avg_vis.tif")
nl_raster00 <- raster("F152000.v4b_web.stable_lights.avg_vis.tif")
nl_raster05 <- raster("F162005.v4b_web.stable_lights.avg_vis.tif")
nl_raster10 <- raster("F182010.v4d_web.stable_lights.avg_vis.tif")

# Prepare distinct grid-year combinations
grid_coords_year <- final_data %>%
  select(lon, lat, year) %>%
  distinct()

# Assign time bands
grid_coords_year <- grid_coords_year %>%
  mutate(
    time_band = case_when(
      year >= 1995 & year <= 1999 ~ "1995",
      year >= 2000 & year <= 2004 ~ "2000",
      year >= 2005 & year <= 2009 ~ "2005",
      year >= 2010                ~ "2010"
    )
  )

# Convert to sf for spatial extraction
grid_coords_year_sf <- st_as_sf(grid_coords_year, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Extract from each raster
extract_nl <- function(sf_data, raster) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(sf_data)
  lights <- raster::extract(raster, sf_data)
  
  tibble(
    lon = coords[,1],
    lat = coords[,2],
    year = sf_data$year,
    nightlight = lights
  )
}

# Split by time band and extract
nl_extracted <- bind_rows(
  extract_nl(filter(grid_coords_year_sf, time_band == "1995"), nl_raster95),
  extract_nl(filter(grid_coords_year_sf, time_band == "2000"), nl_raster00),
  extract_nl(filter(grid_coords_year_sf, time_band == "2005"), nl_raster05),
  extract_nl(filter(grid_coords_year_sf, time_band == "2010"), nl_raster10)
)

# Merge back into final_data
final_data <- final_data %>%
  left_join(nl_extracted, by = c("lon", "lat", "year"))

# Normalize
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(nightlight_z = scale(nightlight)[,1])
```

```{r, vulnerability control}
nd_gain <- read.csv("vulnerability.csv")

# remove the X from column names
colnames(nd_gain) <- sub("^X", "", colnames(nd_gain))

# Reshape to long-format
nd_gain_long <- pivot_longer(nd_gain,
                              cols = matches("^\\d{4}$"),  # Only year columns
                              names_to = "year",
                              values_to = "nd_gain_score") %>% 
  rename(country = Name)

# Adjusting country names
nd_gain_long$country[nd_gain_long$country == "Congo, the Democratic Republic o"] <- "Democratic Republic of the Congo"
nd_gain_long$country[nd_gain_long$country == "Libyan Arab Jamahiriya"] <- "Libya"
nd_gain_long$country[nd_gain_long$country == "Swaziland"] <- "Eswatini"
nd_gain_long$country[nd_gain_long$country == "Tanzania, United Republic of"] <- "Tanzania"
nd_gain_long$country[nd_gain_long$country == "Congo"] <- "Congo"

# Filter
nd_gain_filtered <- nd_gain_long %>%
  filter(year %in% 1995:2010,
         country %in% final_data$country)%>% 
  select(-ISO3)

# Change class of year
nd_gain_filtered$year <- as.integer(nd_gain_filtered$year)

# Creating disputed countries
nd_gain_extra <- nd_gain_filtered %>%
  filter(country %in% c("Morocco", "Sudan", "Somalia")) %>%
  mutate(country = recode(country,
                          "Morocco" = "W. Sahara",
                          "Sudan" = "South Sudan",
                          "Somalia" = "Somaliland")) 

# Combine with the main data set
nd_gain_augmented <- bind_rows(nd_gain_filtered, nd_gain_extra)

# Join 
final_data <- left_join(final_data, nd_gain_augmented,
                        by = c("country" = "country", "year" = "year"))
                        
summary(final_data$nd_gain_score)
unique(final_data$year)

# Saving my progress
write.csv( final_data, "NEWclimateconflictcontrols.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, cropland control}
# Load
final_data <- read.csv("NEWclimateconflictcontrols.csv")
# Set path to the folder containing the TIFFs
tif_folder <- "C:/Users/Pauli/Documents/Uni 6. Semester/Bachelor Arbeit/Data Teil/MODIS_data"

# List only LC_Type1 TIFFs
lc_files <- list.files(tif_folder, pattern = "LC_Type1.*\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

# Sort by year 
years <- str_extract(lc_files, "(?<=doy)\\d{4}")
lc_files <- lc_files[order(as.integer(years))]  # sort chronologically

# Load as a raster stack
lc_stack <- rast(lc_files)

# Name each layer by its year
names(lc_stack) <- paste0("lc_", years[order(as.integer(years))])

# Quick check
print(lc_stack)
plot(lc_stack[[1]])  # first year land cover

# Merging with final data
# Prepare points and land cover year column
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(lc_year = ifelse(year < 2001, 2001, year))

final_data$row_id <- seq_len(nrow(final_data))

# Convert to SpatVector
points <- vect(final_data, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

points_proj <- project(points, crs(lc_stack))

# Split final_data by lc_year
split_data <- split(final_data, final_data$lc_year)

# Initialize list to store extraction results
extract_list <- lapply(split_data, function(df_group) {
  layer_name <- paste0("lc_", unique(df_group$lc_year))
  
  # Safety check
  if (!(layer_name %in% names(lc_stack))) {
    stop(paste("Layer", layer_name, "not found in lc_stack"))
  }
  
  # Extract points by row_id
  these_points <- points_proj[df_group$row_id, ]
  
  # Extract raster values
  vals <- terra::extract(lc_stack[[layer_name]], these_points)
  
  # Return row_id and extracted value
  tibble(row_id = df_group$row_id, lc_type1 = vals[, 2])
})

# Combine all extractions
lc_extracts <- bind_rows(extract_list)

# Merge back into final_data
final_data <- final_data %>%
  left_join(lc_extracts, by = "row_id") %>%
  select(-row_id, -lc_year)

# Create a dummy for cropland presence
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(cropland_dummy = ifelse(lc_type1 %in% c(12, 14), 1, 0))

ggplot(final_data, aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = factor(cropland_dummy))) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey85", "1" = "darkgreen"),
                    name = "Cropland",
                    labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Presence of Cropland by Grid Cell",
       subtitle = "Based on MODIS Land Cover (LC_Type1)")
```

```{r, other agriculture controls}
# Define MODIS Q2 folder and variables
q2_folder <- "C:/Users/Pauli/Documents/Uni 6. Semester/Bachelor Arbeit/Data Teil/Modis Q2"
modis_vars <- c("Dormancy_1", "Greenup_1", "EVI_Amplitude_1", "NumCycles")

# Add row_id to keep join integrity
final_data$row_id <- seq_len(nrow(final_data))
points <- vect(final_data, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

# Loop over all variables
for (var in modis_vars) {
  
  message("Processing: ", var)
  
  # Get files for the variable
  var_files <- list.files(q2_folder, pattern = paste0(var, ".*\\.tif$"), full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(var_files) == 0) next  
  
  # Extract years
  years <- str_extract(var_files, "(?<=doy)\\d{4}")
  var_stack <- rast(var_files)
  names(var_stack) <- make.unique(paste0(var, "_", years))
  
  # Aggregate to 1°x1°
  var_agg <- aggregate(var_stack, fact = 240, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Match year in panel (fall back to 2001 for earlier years)
  modis_years <- as.integer(str_extract(names(var_agg), "\\d{4}"))
  min_year <- min(modis_years)
  
  final_data <- final_data %>%
    mutate(temp_year = ifelse(year < min_year, min_year, year))
  
  # Split panel by year
  split_data <- split(final_data, final_data$temp_year)
  
  # Extract from year-matched layer
  extract_list <- lapply(split_data, function(df_group) {
    layer_name <- paste0(var, "_", unique(df_group$temp_year))
    layer_idx <- grep(paste0("^", layer_name), names(var_agg))
    
    if (length(layer_idx) == 0) return(tibble(row_id = df_group$row_id, value = NA))
    
    layer_to_extract <- if (length(layer_idx) > 1) {
      mean(var_agg[[layer_idx]], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      var_agg[[layer_idx]]
    }
    
    these_points <- points[df_group$row_id, ]
    vals <- terra::extract(layer_to_extract, these_points)
    
    tibble(row_id = df_group$row_id, value = vals[, 2])
  })
  
  # Combine & merge
  var_extract <- bind_rows(extract_list)
  names(var_extract)[2] <- var
  
  final_data <- left_join(final_data, var_extract, by = "row_id")
}

# Clean up
final_data <- final_data %>% select(-row_id, -temp_year)


plot(var_stack[[1]])  # for any variable
points(final_data$lon, final_data$lat, pch = ".", col = "red")

ggplot(final_data, aes(x = lon, y = lat)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = NumCycles)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "red") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal()

# Calculate growing season length with wraparound handling
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(
    growing_season_length = case_when(
      is.na(Greenup_1) | is.na(Dormancy_1) ~ NA_real_,
      Dormancy_1 >= Greenup_1 ~ Dormancy_1 - Greenup_1,
      TRUE ~ (365 - Greenup_1) + Dormancy_1
    ),
    double_season = ifelse(NumCycles >= 2, 1, 0)
  )

# Normalize variables (full panel)
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(
    gsl_z = scale(growing_season_length)[, 1],
    evi_z = scale(EVI_Amplitude_1)[, 1],
    double_z = scale(double_season)[, 1]
  )

# Calculate ASII (equal weights)
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(
    ag_season_intensity = rowMeans(select(., gsl_z, evi_z, double_z), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Dummy for missings (Sahara/ Jungle)
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(missing_agri = as.integer(is.na(ag_season_intensity)))
```

```{r, population density control}
pop_2010 <- rast("C:/Users/Pauli/Documents/Uni 6. Semester/Bachelor Arbeit/Data Teil/World pop GWP4/GPW_UN_Adj_PopDensity.411_population-density_doy2010182_aid0001.tif")

# Extract per group
extract_list <- lapply(split_data, function(df_group) {

  these_points <- points[df_group$row_id, ]
  vals <- terra::extract(pop_stack[[layer_name]], these_points)
  tibble(row_id = df_group$row_id, pop_density = vals[, 2])
})

# Merge back into final_data
```

```{r, ethnic fractionalization control}
geo_epr <- st_read("C:/Users/Pauli/Documents/Uni 6. Semester/Bachelor Arbeit/Data Teil/GeoEPR-2021.shp")
epr_attr <- read.csv("EPR-2021.csv")

# Join GeoEPR with EPR attributes by groupid and year overlap
geo_epr_full <- geo_epr %>%
  left_join(epr_attr %>% select(groupid, from, to, status), by = c("groupid", "from", "to")) %>%
  filter(from <= 2010 & to >= 1996)

# Fix CRS
geo_epr_full <- st_transform(geo_epr_full, crs = 4326)

# Drop invalid geometries
geo_epr_full <- geo_epr_full[st_is_valid(geo_epr_full), ]

# Making sure final_data_sf exists
final_data_sf <- st_as_sf(final_data, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Join
grid_with_groups <- st_join(final_data_sf, geo_epr_full, join = st_intersects, left = TRUE)

# Filter
grid_with_groups <- grid_with_groups %>%
  filter(year >= from & year <= to)


grid_with_groups <- grid_with_groups %>%
  mutate(lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1],
         lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2])

ethnic_summary <- grid_with_groups %>%
  mutate(
    status_clean = toupper(trimws(status))  # standardize
  ) %>%
  group_by(lon, lat, year) %>%
  summarise(
    has_excluded_group = any(status_clean %in% c("DISCRIMINATED", "POWERLESS"), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ethnic_groups = n_distinct(groupid),
    most_common_status = if (all(is.na(status_clean))) NA_character_ else names(sort(table(status_clean), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check
summary(ethnic_summary$has_excluded_group)

# Round
ethnic_summary <- ethnic_summary %>%
  mutate(
    lon = round(lon, 0),  
    lat = round(lat, 0)
  )

# Join back with final_data
final_data <- final_data %>%
  left_join(ethnic_summary, by = c("lon", "lat", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    has_excluded_group = replace_na(has_excluded_group, FALSE),
    n_ethnic_groups = replace_na(n_ethnic_groups, 0),
    most_common_status = replace_na(most_common_status, "None")
  )

# Cleanup before saving
final_data <- final_data %>% 
  select(-geometry, -date)

# Saving final dataset
write.csv(final_data, "ClimateConflict_BAdata_PaulinaWolf.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
